criteria.criterion: Claude is in use for vloop run when any of agent.plan, agent.gate-review, agent.work, agent.review resolves to claude, or agent.verify does while run.verify is not false, or agent.second-review does while run.second-review is not off; for vloop doctor the same, or agent.review-brief resolves to claude.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/doctor.go claudeInUse: the four keys, verify gated on run.verify != false, second-review gated on secondReviewMode != off, review-brief only when runBrief == nil (bare doctor).

criteria.criterion: When the config row is a problem, Claude counts as in use and the four rows run as today.
criteria.evidence: doctor.go:117 claudeUsed := cerr != nil || ...; unreadable keys also count as claude.

criteria.criterion: When Claude is in use the claude, trust, plugin and gate edits rows are exactly as today. When it is not, each is n/a with the message `no session in use runs on claude` (`- claude no session in use runs on claude`, and the same for trust, plugin and gate edits), runs nothing (no claude --version, no plugin list) and reads nothing (no ~/.claude.json, no settings file); vloop run's preflight passes them.
criteria.evidence: doctor.go: each of the four rows branches on !claudeUsed to resNA with claudeNotInUse before doctorClaude/doctorTrusted/doctorPlugin/doctorGateEdits are called; in-use paths unchanged. The e2e test checks the run passes preflight.

criteria.criterion: Violation: a Claude row skipped on a repository where some session in use is on Claude, or a Claude row still run when none is.
criteria.evidence: Both directions covered by TestClaudeRowsNotInUseWithoutClaude and TestClaudeRowsInUseWhenReviewIsClaude.

criteria.criterion: vloop brief review's preflight is unchanged. Earlier doctor tests change only where they pin rows for Claude not in use.
criteria.evidence: brief_review.go does not call runDoctor; the diff touches no earlier test (only additions to b39_local_config_test.go); go check passed.

criteria.criterion: A committed end-to-end test in cmd/vloop, on a temporary PATH holding a stub copilot and no claude, every agent.* key copilot with a Copilot model id and run.verify = false, asserts each of the four n/a lines on its own (not as one block) and that vloop run gets past its preflight; with agent.review set back to claude it asserts `✗ claude claude is not on PATH` and the preflight's refusal. No test depends on what is installed on the machine. The go check runs it.
criteria.evidence: cmd/vloop/b39_local_config_test.go: noClaudeRepo builds a PATH with only the stub and symlinked git/sh tools; the first test loops over the four lines and asserts each separately, then asserts the run's plan session started; the second asserts the ✗ line, 'preflight failed', and no session or commit. go check log is green.
